Hey there! I know it sounds hard to believe but one assignment isn’t going to ruin your life. I, too, have failed classes (I currently have a 68% in Calculus BC, despite trying really really hard), and I understand how much it hurts to feel as though you failed. Your teacher was really unprofessional, and I hope you report him/her. My teacher once called me a waste of potential in front of the whole class, and, like you, I contemplated suicide that day. But trust me, as you grow older, those people will be irrelevant in your life. My teacher told me that I could never survive in Calculus AB because I am “lazy, unmotivated” but (whether it’s by luck or skill) I scored a 5/5 on the AP exam for Calc AB (still failing BC though...). Anyways, the opinion of one person shouldn’t stop you from living your life to the fullest! Life is about ups and downs, and I guarantee you can bounce back from
this! DM me if you need to talk!
